graph_bfs_minimumknightmoves.png.title: Minimum Knight Moves
graph_bfs_minimumknightmoves.png.problem: On an infinite chessboard, a knight starts at (0, 0). Return the minimum number of moves needed to reach the square (x, y).

graph_bfs_minimummovestomoveabox.png.title: Minimum Moves to Move a Box to Their Target Location
graph_bfs_minimummovestomoveabox.png.problem: In a grid with walls, a player, a box and a target, the player walks freely and pushes the box by moving into it. Return the minimum number of pushes to get the box onto the target, or -1.

graph_bfs_routermessagereachability.png.title: Router Message Reachability
graph_bfs_routermessagereachability.png.problem: Given router coordinates and a wireless range, a router can send directly to any router within that distance. Return whether a message from a source router can reach a target router.

graph_dfs_clonegraph.png.title: Clone Graph
graph_dfs_clonegraph.png.problem: Given a reference to a node in a connected undirected graph, return a deep copy of the whole graph.

graph_dfs_countlakesin2dgrid.png.title: Count Lakes in a 2D Grid
graph_dfs_countlakesin2dgrid.png.problem: Given a 2D grid of land and water cells, return the number of lakes, where a lake is a group of 4-directionally connected water cells.

graph_dfs_countsubislands.png.title: Count Sub Islands
graph_dfs_countsubislands.png.problem: Given two binary grids of the same size, return the number of islands in grid2 whose every cell is also land in grid1.

graph_dfs_evaluatedivision.png.title: Evaluate Division
graph_dfs_evaluatedivision.png.problem: Given equations like a / b = k and a list of queries x / y, return the value of each query, or -1.0 if it cannot be determined.

graph_dfs_floodfill.png.title: Flood Fill
graph_dfs_floodfill.png.problem: Given an image grid, a starting pixel and a new color, recolor the starting pixel and all 4-directionally connected pixels of the same original color, and return the image.

graph_dfs_numberofclosedislands.png.title: Number of Closed Islands
graph_dfs_numberofclosedislands.png.problem: Given a grid where 0 is land and 1 is water, return the number of closed islands, meaning land groups completely surrounded by water and not touching the grid border.

graph_dfs_numberofprovinces.png.title: Number of Provinces
graph_dfs_numberofprovinces.png.problem: Given an n x n adjacency matrix of directly connected cities, return the number of provinces (groups of directly or indirectly connected cities).

graph_dfs_pacificatlanticwaterflow.png.title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
graph_dfs_pacificatlanticwaterflow.png.problem: Given a height grid with the Pacific touching the top/left edges and the Atlantic the bottom/right, water flows to neighbors of equal or lower height. Return all cells from which water can reach both oceans.

graph_dijkstra_findthesafestpathinagrid..title: Find the Safest Path in a Grid
graph_dijkstra_findthesafestpathinagrid..problem: Given a grid with thieves, the safeness of a path is the minimum Manhattan distance from any cell on it to any thief. Return the maximum safeness of a path from the top-left to the bottom-right.

graph_dijkstra_minimumsecurityclearance..title: Minimum Security Clearance
graph_dijkstra_minimumsecurityclearance..problem: Given a graph whose edges require a security level, find the minimum clearance needed to travel from a source to a destination (the path's maximum edge requirement). A variant also breaks ties by minimum total travel cost.

graph_dijkstra_networkdelaytime.png.title: Network Delay Time
graph_dijkstra_networkdelaytime.png.problem: Given a weighted directed network of n nodes and a source k, return the time for a signal from k to reach all nodes, or -1 if some node is unreachable.

graph_dijkstra_pathwithmaximumminimumval.title: Path With Maximum Minimum Value
graph_dijkstra_pathwithmaximumminimumval.problem: Given an integer grid, return the maximum possible score of a 4-directional path from top-left to bottom-right, where a path's score is the minimum value along it.

graph_dijkstra_themaze2.png.title: The Maze II
graph_dijkstra_themaze2.png.problem: A ball in a maze rolls in one direction until it hits a wall. Return the shortest distance (cells traveled) for the ball to stop at the destination, or -1 if impossible.

graph_hierholzer_reconstructitinerary.pn.title: Reconstruct Itinerary
graph_hierholzer_reconstructitinerary.pn.problem: Given a list of airline tickets [from, to], reconstruct the itinerary starting at JFK that uses every ticket exactly once, returning the lexicographically smallest one if several exist.

graph_multisourcebfs_rottingoranges.png.title: Rotting Oranges
graph_multisourcebfs_rottingoranges.png.problem: In a grid of empty cells, fresh and rotten oranges, each minute rotten oranges rot their 4-directional fresh neighbors. Return the minutes until no fresh orange remains, or -1 if impossible.

graph_multisourcebfs_wallsandgates.png.title: Walls and Gates
graph_multisourcebfs_wallsandgates.png.problem: Given a grid of walls (-1), gates (0) and empty rooms (INF), fill each empty room in place with the distance to its nearest gate, leaving INF if unreachable.

graph_prim_mincosttoconnectallpoints.png.title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
graph_prim_mincosttoconnectallpoints.png.problem: Given points on a 2D plane, return the minimum total cost to connect all of them, where connecting two points costs their Manhattan distance.

graph_retrogradebfs_catandmouse.png.title: Cat and Mouse
graph_retrogradebfs_catandmouse.png.problem: A mouse (starting at node 1) and a cat (starting at node 2) alternate moves on an undirected graph; the mouse wins by reaching the hole at node 0, the cat by catching the mouse (the cat cannot enter the hole). With optimal play, return 1 if the mouse wins, 2 if the cat wins, or 0 for a draw.

graph_topo_aliendictionary.png.title: Alien Dictionary
graph_topo_aliendictionary.png.problem: Given a list of words sorted in an unknown alien alphabet, return a valid ordering of the letters, or an empty string if the input is inconsistent.

graph_topo_buildamatrixwithconditions.pn.title: Build a Matrix With Conditions
graph_topo_buildamatrixwithconditions.pn.problem: Given k and lists of row conditions [above, below] and column conditions [left, right], build a k x k matrix containing each number 1..k exactly once (rest 0) that satisfies them all, or return an empty matrix.

graph_topo_coursescheduleii.png.title: Course Schedule II
graph_topo_coursescheduleii.png.problem: Given numCourses and prerequisite pairs, return an order in which you can take all courses, or an empty array if it is impossible.

graph_topo_sequencereconstruction.png.title: Sequence Reconstruction
graph_topo_sequencereconstruction.png.problem: Given a permutation nums and a list of subsequences, return whether nums is the only shortest supersequence consistent with all of them.

greedy_counting_taskscheduler.png.title: Task Scheduler
greedy_counting_taskscheduler.png.problem: Given CPU tasks labeled by letters and a cooldown n between identical tasks, return the minimum number of time units (including idle) needed to finish all tasks.

greedy_differencearray_minimumnumberofin.title: Minimum Number of Increments on Subarrays to Form a Target Array
greedy_differencearray_minimumnumberofin.problem: Starting from an all-zero array, each operation increments every element of a chosen subarray by 1. Return the minimum number of operations to form the given target array.

greedy_linefill_numberoflinestowritestri.title: Number of Lines To Write String
greedy_linefill_numberoflinestowritestri.problem: Given pixel widths for each letter and a string, write it on lines at most 100 pixels wide. Return the number of lines used and the width of the last line.

hashing_counting_findoriginalarrayfromdo.title: Find Original Array From Doubled Array
hashing_counting_findoriginalarrayfromdo.problem: An array was formed by appending twice each element of an original array and shuffling. Given it, return the original array, or an empty array if it is not a valid doubled array.

hashing_counting_senderwithlargestwordco.title: Sender With Largest Word Count
hashing_counting_senderwithlargestwordco.problem: Given parallel lists of chat messages and their senders, return the sender with the largest total word count, breaking ties by the lexicographically largest name.

hashing_groupby_friendrecommendations.pn.title: Friend Recommendations
hashing_groupby_friendrecommendations.pn.problem: Given song-listen records (user, song, day) and existing friendships, recommend pairs of users who are not yet friends but listened to at least three of the same songs on the same day.

hashing_hashset_longestconsecutivesequen.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
hashing_hashset_longestconsecutivesequen.problem: Given an unsorted integer array, return the length of the longest run of consecutive integers it contains, in O(n) time.

hashing_normalize_groupshiftedstrings.pn.title: Group Shifted Strings
hashing_normalize_groupshiftedstrings.pn.problem: Given a list of strings, group together those that belong to the same shifting sequence, where shifting moves every letter forward by one (wrapping z to a).

hashing_remapping_randompickwithblacklis.title: Random Pick with Blacklist
hashing_remapping_randompickwithblacklis.problem: Given n and a blacklist of integers in [0, n), design pick() to return a uniformly random integer in [0, n) that is not blacklisted, minimizing calls to the random function.

heap_greedymatching_processorderspartial.title: Process Orders with Partial Fulfillment
heap_greedymatching_processorderspartial.problem: Given supply orders (Fizz) with costs and quantities, and demand orders (Buzz) with quantities, fill each demand from the cheapest available supply, allowing partial fills, and report the resulting matches or costs.

heap_kway_mergeksortedlists.png.title: Merge K Sorted Lists
heap_kway_mergeksortedlists.png.problem: Given an array of k sorted linked lists, merge them into one sorted linked list and return it.

heap_sweepline_skylineproblem.png.title: The Skyline Problem
heap_sweepline_skylineproblem.png.problem: Given buildings as [left, right, height], return the skyline as a list of key points where the outline's height changes.

heap_topk_findtop5largestfilesindirector.title: Top 5 Largest Files in a Directory Tree
heap_topk_findtop5largestfilesindirector.problem: Given a file system API with list_dir(path) and size_of(path), return the five largest files under a root directory, sorted by size descending.

heap_topk_movierecommendationsystem.png.title: Movie Recommendation System
heap_topk_movierecommendationsystem.png.problem: Given a catalog of movies with genres, cast, director and rating, and a target movie, return the top K most similar movies under a weighted similarity score, breaking ties by id.
